content.name: Amélie Tremblay
content.title: Staff Software Engineer
content.summary: Staff engineer with 12 years building event-driven back ends in Java, Kotlin and Go, including trading-adjacent and energy-metering platforms. Sets technical direction for three teams (22 engineers) and led a Kafka re-architecture that processes 1.8 billion meter readings a month. Bilingual in English and French.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Rebuilt the seat-reservation service in Java with optimistic locking, eliminating double-sold seats during on-sales of up to 40,000 tickets in ten minutes.
Added a French-language checkout for Québec venues, opening a market that grew to 15% of ticket revenue within a year.
Wrote the team's first load-testing suite in Gatling and used it to size infrastructure for three stadium tours.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Owned the trade-reconciliation pipeline for 11 dealer clients, reconciling about 2 million records nightly with a break rate under 0.05%.
Migrated batch reconciliation from overnight cron jobs to Kafka Streams, so breaks surfaced within minutes instead of the next morning.
Hired and onboarded six engineers and wrote the backend interview loop the company still uses.
Worked with the compliance team to produce audit trails that satisfied two external reviews with no findings on data lineage.

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullets: Set architecture for ingestion, billing and forecasting teams (22 engineers) and chair the weekly design review.
Led a re-architecture of meter ingestion onto Kafka and Go consumers that now handles 1.8 billion readings a month at a cloud cost $410,000 a year lower than the old design.
Defined service-level objectives for 30 services and an error-budget policy, cutting customer-reported outages from nine in 2022 to two in 2025.
Sponsor an internal staff-plus mentoring circle that has supported four promotions to senior.

education.details: Five co-op terms in backend and QA roles. Capstone: low-latency order book simulator.

courses.name: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka

achievements.title: Two granted patents on streaming reconciliation
achievements.detail: Co-inventor on methods for detecting out-of-order trade events, filed while at Bay Street Ledger Technologies.

achievements.title: Conference talk, Toronto JVM meetup
achievements.detail: Presented lessons from moving a billing system from batch to streams to around 200 attendees.
